title: Carson's Aglow | Sunday, November 29
seo_title: Carson's Aglow Holiday Lights in Springfield, MO
description: Carson's Aglow is an evening Christmas lights event at Carson's Greenhouse & Gifts, with illuminated wooded trails, festive photo spots, and holiday activities. Admission is $20 for adults (13+) and $15 for children 4–12, with ages 3 and under and veterans and active military free; each full-experience admission includes unlimited hot cocoa, a bag of Christmas cookies, and a Christmas craft, while fire pit rentals require separate admission. It takes place Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM at 234 E Farm Road 192 in Springfield, MO.
